title: Writing Descriptions
ringkas: Orang, tempat, dan benda dengan detail yang hidup
goals: menulis **deskripsi orang, tempat, dan benda** dengan detail
memakai **kata sifat yang kuat** dan urutan kata sifat
memakai **lima indra** untuk membuat tulisan hidup

lesson.text: Deskripsi yang baik membuat pembaca **melihat, mendengar, dan merasakan** apa yang kamu tulis. Gunakan detail spesifik, kata sifat yang kuat, dan lima indra, bukan kata-kata umum seperti *nice* atau *good*.

lesson.title: 1. Dari umum ke spesifik
table: [[The room is bright and tidy, with a soft blue carpet.]]
[[The soup is hot, salty, and full of fresh vegetables.]]
[[She has long black hair and a warm smile.]]
[[It was enormous, taller than any building in the town.]]

examples.en: [[The kitchen smelled of fresh bread, and the floor was warm under my feet.]]
examples.id: Dapur beraroma roti segar, dan lantai terasa hangat di kakiku.

lesson.title: 3. Urutan kata sifat
table: opini → ukuran → usia → warna → asal → bahan → benda
[[a lovely small old brown wooden box]]

lesson.title: Hindari kata umum
lesson.text: Ganti *nice*, *good*, *bad*, *big* dengan kata yang lebih spesifik: *friendly*, *delicious*, *terrible*, *enormous*.

items: Detail spesifik > kata umum.
Gunakan lima indra.
Urutan kata sifat: opini, ukuran, usia, warna, asal, bahan.
Perbandingan: as ... as, like.

options: The old market was noisy, crowded, and full of the smell of fried fish.
The market was nice and I enjoyed going there with my friends.
The market was big and good, and I want to go there again.
I like the market because it is a place where people buy things.
She has long black hair and a warm smile.
She is pretty and nice, and everybody in the class likes her.
She looks good, and her clothes are very good as well.
She is nice, and she is also a very good person to know.

practice.q: Pilih deskripsi yang memakai indra pendengaran:
options: The street was loud with cars and horns.
The street was long and went from the school to the market.
The street was gray and the buildings beside it were all new.
The street was new, and many shops were built along its side.
practice.exp: Loud. Jawaban yang tepat: **The street was loud with cars and horns.**

practice.q: Pilih deskripsi yang memakai indra penciuman:
options: The kitchen smelled of fresh bread.
The kitchen was tidy and the table in it was clean and white.
The kitchen was small, but it had a window and a table.
The kitchen was bright because the lights were on all day.
practice.exp: Smelled. Jawaban yang tepat: **The kitchen smelled of fresh bread.**

practice.q: Pilih pembuka deskripsi tempat yang menarik:
options: As soon as I opened the door, the smell of coffee wrapped around me.
This is a place where I like to go and sit down for an hour.
I will write about a place that I know very well in my town.
The place is a place that is in the city near my school.

practice.q: Apa yang sebaiknya dihindari dalam deskripsi?
options: kata umum seperti nice dan good
kata sifat yang spesifik dan sesuai konteks
detail dari lima indra dalam deskripsi
perbandingan sederhana seperti as cold as ice

practice.q: The water was as cold as ___.

practice.id: Sebuah kotak kayu kecil tua yang indah.

items: The house was old and quiet.
A big green wooden gate stood at the front.
The garden has colourful many flowers.
It smelled of rain and earth.
She wore a long red dress.
Her hair was shiny and black.
She has a warm, friendly smile.
She walks like very slowly a turtle.
practice.exp: She walks as slowly as a turtle.

practice.q: Susun kalimat-kalimat berikut menjadi paragraf yang runtut.
items: I woke up early and opened the window.
The air was cool and smelled of wet grass.
I could hear birds singing in the trees.
It was the most peaceful morning of the month.
practice.exp: Dari tindakan, indra penciuman, pendengaran, ke kesan akhir.
